title: Line interruption between Node A and Node B (shutdown confirmed)
description: After 3 s the simulated conductor between Node A and Node B parts. Node A keeps voltage; Nodes B and C lose it. The simulated controller orders its switch to open and the switch's feedback signal reports OPEN.
what_to_look_for: Status goes to ISOLATION PENDING for about a second, then ISOLATED.
The faulty section is shown between Node A and Node B.
Shutdown commanded: Yes. Switch feedback confirms: Yes.

steps.note: Simulated conductor parts between Node A and Node B
